```{r Importation des données}
# SACROIS
sacrois <- read.csv("C:/Users/Stagiaire/Desktop/LOLA/STAGE/R/output/sacrois_2016-2025_licence_combo.csv")

s0 <- sacrois %>%
  select(!X) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  select(immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur, saison, date, poids) %>%
  arrange(nom_navire, date)

s0 <- unique(s0)

# Données Télécapêche
tecap <- read.csv("C:/Users/Stagiaire/Desktop/LOLA/STAGE/R/output/telecapeche_2014-2025_navire.csv")

t0 <- tecap %>%
  select(!X) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         immat_combo = immat_final) %>%
  select(immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur, saison, date, poids, destination)%>%

```

```{r pecheur communs tecap sacrois}
t1_1 <- t0 %>%
  filter(saison %in% s0$saison)

pecheurs_communs <- intersect(unique(s0$pecheur), unique(t1_1$pecheur))

s1 <- s0 %>%
  filter(pecheur %in% pecheurs_communs)

t1 <- t1_1 %>%
  filter(pecheur %in% pecheurs_communs)

length(unique(s1$pecheur))
length(unique(t1$pecheur))
```

# Préparation générale
```{r 1 préparation}
  s1 <- as.data.table(copy(s1))
  t1 <- as.data.table(copy(t1))
  
  s1[, date := as.Date(date)]
  t1[, date := as.Date(date)]
  
  s1[, id := paste(immat_combo, pecheur, saison, sep = "_")]
  t1[, id := paste(immat_combo, pecheur, saison, sep = "_")]
  
  setorder(s1, id, date)
  setorder(t1, id, date)
  
  s1[, declaration_cumule := FALSE]
```

# Etape 1   Cumulation
```{r etape 1 paramètres}
window_max = 10
tol = 0.1
time_tol = 5
```

### 1. Détection cumul
```{r 1 detec cumul}
s2 <- copy(s1)

for (w in 2:window_max) {
    
    s2[, past_sum :=
         frollsum(poids, n = w, align = "right", fill = NA), by = id]
    
    s2[, past_sum := shift(past_sum, 1, type = "lag"), by = id]
    
    s2[!is.na(past_sum) & abs(poids - past_sum) <= tol, declaration_cumule := TRUE]
  }
```

### 1. Matching Télécapêche
```{r 1 matching tecap}
# Cas cumulés
s2_cum <- s2[declaration_cumule == TRUE, .(id,
                                           date,
                                           poids_s2 = poids,
                                           start = date - time_tol,
                                           end   = date + time_tol)]

setkey(s2_cum, id, start, end)

# T1
t1_match <- t1[, .(id,
                   date,
                   poids_t1 = poids,
                   start = date,
                   end   = date)]

setkey(t1_match, id, start, end)

# Overlap temporel
matches_cum <- foverlaps(s2_cum, t1_match, nomatch = 0)
```

### 1. Analyse des matchs
```{r 1 analyse des matchs}
# Match exact
matches_cum[, exact_match := abs(poids_s2 - poids_t1) <= tol]
             

# Totaux T1
t1_total <- t1[, .(total_t1 = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE)), by = id]

matches_cum <- merge(matches_cum,
                     t1_total,
                     by = "id",
                     all.x = TRUE)

# Match agrégé
matches_cum[, total_match := abs(total_t1 - poids_s2) <= tol]
```

### 1. Réintégration dans s2
```{r 1 reintegration dans s2}
match_flags_cum <- unique(matches_cum[, .(id,
                                          date,
                                          exact_match,
                                          total_match)])

s2 <- merge(s2,
            match_flags_cum,
            by = c("id", "date"),
            all.x = TRUE)

s2[is.na(exact_match), exact_match := FALSE]
s2[is.na(total_match), total_match := FALSE]
```

### 1. Status cumul
```{r 1 status cumul}
s2[, status_cumul := fifelse(declaration_cumule & exact_match,
                             "cumulative_verified_structure",
                             fifelse(declaration_cumule & total_match,
                                     "cumulative_verified_total_only",
                                     fifelse(declaration_cumule,
                                             "suspect_cumulative",
                                             "ok")))]
```

# Etape 2  Répétition
```{r 2 paramètres}
repeat_tol <- 10
weight_tol <- 0
time_tol <- 5
```

### 2. Détection répétition
```{r 2 detec repet}
s3 <- copy(s2)

s3[, lag_poids := shift(poids), by = id]
s3[, lag_date  := shift(date), by = id]

s3[, diff_days := as.numeric(date - lag_date)]

s3[, repeated :=
      !is.na(lag_poids) &
      abs(poids - lag_poids) <= weight_tol &
      diff_days >= 1 &
      diff_days <= repeat_tol]
```

### 2. Préparation matching
```{r 2 prepa matching}
s3_rep <- s3[repeated == TRUE, .(id,
                                 date,
                                 poids_s3 = poids,
                                 start = date - time_tol,
                                 end   = date + time_tol)]

setkey(s3_rep, id, start, end)

t1_match <- t1[, .(id,
                   date,
                   poids_t1 = poids,
                   start = date,
                   end   = date)]

setkey(t1_match, id, start, end)
```

### 2. Matching
```{r 2 matching}
matches_rep <- foverlaps(s3_rep, t1_match, nomatch = 0)

matches_rep[, poids_match := abs(poids_s3 - poids_t1) <= weight_tol]
```

### 2. Réintégration
```{r 2 réintégration}
verified_rep <- unique(matches_rep[poids_match == TRUE, .(id, date)])

verified_rep[, verified_repeat := TRUE]

s3 <- merge(s3,
            verified_rep,
            by = c("id", "date"),
            all.x = TRUE)

s3[is.na(verified_repeat), verified_repeat := FALSE]
```

### 2. Status répétition
```{r 2 status répét}
s3[, status_repeat := fifelse(repeated & verified_repeat,
                              "repeated_but_verified",
                              fifelse(repeated & !verified_repeat,
                                      "suspect_repeat",
                                      "ok"))]
```

# Etape 3  Tolérance mensuel
```{r 3 paramètre}
month_tol <- 5
```

```{r 3 copie s3}
s4 <- copy(s3)
```

### 3. Création variable mois
```{r 3 ajout mois}
s4[, month := format(date, "%Y-%m")]
t1[, month := format(date, "%Y-%m")]
```

### 3. Agrégation mensuel
```{r 3 agrégation mensuel}
s4_month <- s4[, .(poids_s4 = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(id, month)]

t1_month <- t1[, .(poids_t1 = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(id, month)]
```

### 3. Comparaison mensuel
```{r 3 comparaison mois}
month_compare <- merge(s4_month, t1_month, by = c("id", "month"), all = TRUE)
```

### 3. remplacement des Na
```{r 3 remplacement na}
month_compare[is.na(poids_s4), poids_s4 := 0]
month_compare[is.na(poids_t1), poids_t1 := 0]
```

### 3. calcul ecart
```{r 3 calcul ecart}
month_compare[, diff_month := poids_s4 - poids_t1]

month_compare[, abs_diff_month := abs(diff_month)]
```

### 3. Flag mensuel
```{r 3 flag}
month_compare[, month_ok := abs_diff_month <= month_tol]

month_compare[, sacrois_superieur := diff_month > month_tol]
```

### 3. réintégration dans s4
```{r 3 réintégration dans s4}
month_flags <- month_compare[ , .(id,
                                  month,
                                  diff_month,
                                  abs_diff_month,
                                  month_ok)]

s4 <- merge(s4, month_flags, by = c("id", "month"), all.x = TRUE)
```

### 3. status mensuel
```{r 3 status mensuel}
s4[, status_month := fifelse(month_ok,
                             "monthly_consistent",
                             "monthly_inconsistent")]
```

# Etape 4 Tolérance saisonnière
```{r 4 paramètres}
season_tol <- 2
```

```{r 4 copie s4}
s5 <- copy(s4)
```

### 4. Agrégation saisonnière
```{r 4 agrégation saisonnière}
s5_season <- s5[, .(poids_s5_season = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE)), by = id]

t1_season <- t1[, .(poids_t1_season = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE)), by = id]
```

### 4. Comparaison saisonnière 
```{r 4 comparaison saisonnière}
season_compare <- merge(s5_season, t1_season, by = "id", all = TRUE)
```

### 4. Transformation des Na
```{r 4 transfo NA}
season_compare[is.na(poids_s5_season), poids_s5_season := 0]

season_compare[is.na(poids_t1_season), poids_t1_season := 0]
```

### 4. Calcul écart 
```{r 4 calcul écart}
season_compare[, diff_season := poids_s5_season - poids_t1_season]

season_compare[, abs_diff_season := abs(diff_season)]
```

### 4. Flags saisonnier
```{r 4 flags}
season_compare[, season_ok := abs_diff_season <= season_tol]
```

### 4. Réintégration dans s5
```{r 4 reintegration dans s5}
season_flags <- season_compare[, .(id,
                                   diff_season,
                                   abs_diff_season,
                                   season_ok)]

s5 <- merge(s5, season_flags, by = "id", all.x = TRUE)
```

### 4. Status saisonnier 
```{r 4 status saisonnier}
s5[, status_season := fifelse(season_ok,
                              "season_consistent",
                              "season_inconsistent")]
```

# Etape 5 final
### 5. Filtration des cas suspect
```{r 5 filtration des cas suspect}
suspects <- s5[status_cumul != "ok" |
                 status_repeat != "ok" |
                 status_month == "monthly_inconsistent" |
                 status_season == "season_inconsistent"]
```

### 5. Ajout d'un score
```{r}
s5[, risk_score := 0]

s5[status_cumul == "suspect_cumulative", risk_score := risk_score + 3]

s5[status_repeat == "suspect_repeat", risk_score := risk_score + 2]

s5[status_month == "monthly_inconsistent", risk_score := risk_score + 2]

s5[status_season == "season_inconsistent", risk_score := risk_score + 4]
```

### 5. Classification
```{r}
s5[, final_risk := fifelse(risk_score >= 6, "HIGH",
                           fifelse(risk_score >= 3, "MEDIUM",
                                   "LOW"))]
```

# Etape 6 Supression des déclarations suspectes 
```{r 6 question}
s_question <- s5 %>%
  select(immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur, saison, date, poids, lag_poids, lag_date, diff_days, status_cumul, status_repeat, status_month, status_season, diff_month, diff_season, risk_score, final_risk)

cumul_pas_ok <- s_question %>%
  filter(!status_cumul == "ok")
```

```{r 6 isolations des lignes}
s6 <- s5[((status_cumul == "suspect_cumulative" & status_month == "monthly_inconsistent" & diff_month > 0 &
    status_season == "season_inconsistent" & diff_season > 0) |
    (status_repeat == "suspect_repeat" & status_month == "monthly_inconsistent" & diff_month > 0 & status_season == "season_inconsistent" & diff_season > 0))]
```

```{r 6 supression des lignes}
s7 <- s5[!((status_cumul == "suspect_cumulative" & status_month == "monthly_inconsistent" & diff_month > 0 &
    status_season == "season_inconsistent" & diff_season > 0) |
    (status_repeat == "suspect_repeat" & status_month == "monthly_inconsistent" & diff_month > 0 & status_season == "season_inconsistent" & diff_season > 0))]
```

# Etape 7 Comparaison télécapêche et sacrois après
```{r}
sum_s1 <- s1 %>%
  mutate(mois = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(saison, mois) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "SACROIS avant")

sum_s7 <- s7 %>%
  mutate(mois = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(saison, mois) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "SACROIS après")

sum_t1 <- t1 %>%
  mutate(mois = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(saison, mois) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "Télécapêche")

sum_total <- bind_rows(sum_s1, sum_s7, sum_t1)
sum_total <- sum_total %>%
  mutate(mois = factor(mois, 
                       levels = c("novembre", "décembre", "janvier", "février", 
                                  "mars", "avril", "mai"))) %>%
  arrange(saison, mois)

ggplot(sum_total, aes(x=mois, y = poids_tot, color = source, group = source)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2)  +
  labs(title = "Comparaison du total de capture selon la source de déclaration pour le même nombre de pêcheur",
       x = "Mois",
       y = "Total de captures (kg)",
       color = "Source") +
  facet_wrap(~ saison) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```
### 7. Regarder pour les pêcheurs concerné
```{r}
pecheur_suspect <- unique(s6$pecheur)

sum_s1_pec <- s1 %>%

  group_by(saison, mois, immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "SACROIS avant")

sum_s7_pec <- s7 %>%
  mutate(mois = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  filter(pecheur%in%pecheur_suspect) %>%
  group_by(saison, mois, immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "SACROIS après")

sum_t1_pec <- t1 %>%
  mutate(mois = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  filter(pecheur%in%pecheur_suspect) %>%
  group_by(saison, mois, immat_combo, nom_navire, pecheur) %>%
  summarise(poids_tot = sum(poids, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "Télécapêche")

sum_total2 <- bind_rows(sum_s1_pec, sum_s7_pec, sum_t1_pec)
sum_total2 <- sum_total2 %>%
  mutate(mois = factor(mois, 
                       levels = c("novembre", "décembre", "janvier", "février", 
                                  "mars", "avril", "mai"))) %>%
  arrange(pecheur, saison, mois)

g0 <- ggplot(sum_total2, aes(x=mois, y = poids_tot)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = pecheur)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = pecheur, group = pecheur), data = sum_total2 %>% filter(source == "SACROIS avant")) +
  geom_line(aes(color = pecheur, group = pecheur), linetype = "dotted", data = sum_total2 %>% filter(source == "SACROIS après")) +
  geom_line(aes(color = pecheur, group = pecheur), linetype = "dashed", data = sum_total2 %>% filter(source == "Télécapêche")) +
  labs(x = "Mois",
       y = "Total de captures (kg)",
       color = "Source") +
  facet_wrap(~ saison) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black",
                                   size = 11),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

library(plotly)

ggplotly(g0)
```

sac_net <- s7

sac_combo <- sacrois


sac_net1 <- sac_net %>%

sac_combo1 <- sac_combo %>%
  select(!X) %>%
  select(annee, mois, saison, date, immat_combo, navire_combo, pecheur, poids, immat, nom_navire, quartier, stade_anguille_cod)

head(sac_combo1)

  select(-poids) %>%

nrow(sac_net1_enriched) == nrow(sac_net1)

names(sac_combo1)
